lineage.description: Flood extent data was derived from observations by Cambodia's General Department of Cadastre and Geography and represents the spatial extent of major flooding events in the Tonle Sap lake and Mekong River systems. The dataset is provided as vector shapefiles documenting inundated areas during significant flood events.
